text: Send traces, logs, and metrics to Honeycomb by instrumenting applications with the open-source OpenTelemetry standard
quote: Instrument your applications with OpenTelemetry, the open-source standard for collecting telemetry, and send traces, logs, and metrics to Honeycomb.

text: Receives telemetry over native OTLP via gRPC, HTTP/protobuf, and HTTP/JSON
quote: Honeycomb supports receiving telemetry data via OpenTelemetry’s native protocol, OTLP, over gRPC, HTTP/protobuf, and HTTP/JSON.

text: Add custom spans, attributes, and events on top of automatic OpenTelemetry instrumentation
quote: Extend automatic OpenTelemetry instrumentation with custom spans, attributes, and events to capture the specific application behavior you need in Honeycomb.

text: Create counters, histograms, and gauges with OpenTelemetry SDKs and send them to Honeycomb for analysis
quote: Instrument your application with OpenTelemetry SDKs to create counters, histograms, and gauges, and send metrics to Honeycomb for analysis.

text: Stores traces and logs as structured events that are indexed on every field at ingest and can be queried without a predefined schema
quote: In Honeycomb, traces and logs are stored as _structured events_: labeled JSON objects sent over HTTP, indexed automatically on every field at ingest, and queryable without a predefined schema.

text: Query Builder for building queries manually with filters, breakdowns, and calculations
quote: Construct queries against your telemetry data using Query Builder. Add filters, breakdowns, and calculations manually to build a query.

text: Documented query structure with SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT, and HAVING clauses
quote: A query in Honeycomb consists of up to six clauses: SELECT... WHERE... GROUP BY... ORDER BY... LIMIT... HAVING

text: Relational field prefixes (root., parent., child., anyX.) for querying across trace structure
quote: Relational field span prefixes follow your trace structure and include: root.- ... parent.- ... child.- ... anyX.

text: Query Assistant turns natural-language input into Honeycomb queries
quote: Query Assistant is a feature that generates Honeycomb queries based on your natural language query (NLQ) input.

text: Boards act as shared workspaces for organizing queries, monitoring SLOs, collaborating, and saving visualizations
quote: Learn how Boards work as centralized workspaces to organize queries, monitor SLOs, collaborate with teammates, and save visualizations for reuse and sharing.

text: Pre-configured Board Templates for common use cases
quote: we offer pre-configured Board Templates for common use cases... saving you time that would otherwise be spent building Boards manually.

text: Triggers send alerts when user-defined thresholds are crossed
quote: Use triggers to send alerts when thresholds that you define and configure are passed.

text: Define SLOs and get alerted when the SLO error budget is threatened
quote: Use Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to define an agreement regarding delivery of a given service and be alerted when your SLO budget is threatened.

text: Tracks SLO values beyond the retention period and shows them in Budget Burndown and Historical Compliance graphs
quote: Honeycomb will track SLO values past your retention period, but will display these for only the Budget Burndown and Historical Compliance graphs.

text: Route Trigger and SLO alerts to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or a custom webhook
quote: Set up Triggers and SLOs to alert your team when conditions are met, and route notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or a custom webhook.

text: Send Trigger and SLO burn alerts as JSON payloads to any webhook-accepting service or custom integration
quote: Route Honeycomb Trigger and SLO burn alerts to any service that accepts a JSON payload, including third-party tools and custom integrations.

text: Customize webhook alert payloads with dynamic variables that fill in alert context
quote: Customize Honeycomb webhook payloads with dynamic variables that populate alert context for precise, actionable notifications.

text: Transform webhook payload templates with Go template functions to format, filter, and restructure alerts
quote: Transform JSON template data in your Honeycomb webhook payloads using Go template functions to format, filter, and restructure alert content before delivery.

text: Example webhook payload templates for Discord, OpsGenie, and incident.io
quote: Copy and adapt example webhook payload templates for Discord, OpsGenie, and incident.io to customize how Honeycomb alert data is delivered to your tools.

text: Connect any MCP-capable AI agent to Honeycomb so it can query live telemetry and investigate issues
quote: Connect Honeycomb to any AI agent that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so it can query your telemetry, investigate issues, and answer questions using your live Honeycomb data.

text: MCP server exposes discovery, query, trace, Board, Trigger, SLO, and Canvas investigation tools
quote: Reference for the tools Honeycomb MCP exposes to AI agents, including discovery, query, trace, Board, Trigger, SLO, and Canvas investigation tools.

text: Connected agents can diagnose latency or error spikes and find performance outliers with optimization suggestions
quote:
They can:

*   Investigate and diagnose latency or error spikes
*   Identify performance outliers and suggest optimization opportunities

text: Plugin gives AI coding assistants eight skills covering observability, OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and Honeycomb features
quote: Installing the Honeycomb plugin gives your AI assistant eight skills for observability workflows:

text: AI skill for migrating proprietary or legacy instrumentation to OpenTelemetry
quote: **otel-migration**: How to migrate proprietary or legacy instrumentation to OpenTelemetry.

text: Translate existing dashboards and alerts into Honeycomb's query language
quote: Translate existing dashboards and alerts into Honeycomb's query language

text: Guidelines for migrating from Honeycomb Beelines to OpenTelemetry SDKs
quote: Guidlines for migrating from Honeycomb Beelines to OpenTelemetry SDKs.

text: Add skills that supply instructions or context to Canvas investigations
quote: Use skills to add instructions or context to your Canvas investigations.

text: Monitor conversations, LLM calls, tool invocations, errors, and token usage in agent workflows
quote: Monitor conversations, LLM calls, tool invocations, errors, and token usage in your agent workflows.

text: Investigate multi-trace AI conversation sessions and see prompts, tool calls, and failures in the order they happened
quote: Use it to investigate entire conversations (multi-trace sessions over time) and quickly see where prompts, tool calls, and failures happened, in the order they happened.

text: Public API for managing datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more
quote: Build integrations and automate workflows with the Honeycomb API. Programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more.

text: Downloadable OpenAPI spec for the Honeycomb API
quote: You can download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec to use with your own tooling.

text: Add, update, and delete markers from the command line with curl or the Honeymarker CLI
quote: Add, update, and delete Honeycomb markers from the command line using curl or Honeymarker, Honeycomb's lightweight marker management CLI.

text: Kubernetes integration collects application logs, cluster logs, and resource metrics
quote: Honeycomb integrates with Kubernetes to collect your applications' logs, cluster logs, and resource metrics so that you can answer all the questions you have.

text: Kubernetes agent collects resource and status metrics from nodes, pods, containers, and volumes
quote: The Honeycomb Kubernetes agent can also collect resource and status metrics from nodes, pods, containers, and volumes.

text: Free-forever plan with up to 20M events/month and 100M metric data points, plus 2 Triggers, tracing, and BubbleUp
quote: Event Volume: Up to 20M per month ... Our introductory plan, free forever. Includes: 2 Triggers, Distributed Tracing, BubbleUp

text: Choose an EU or North America region for your account
quote: Select Switch to European Union or Switch to North America to choose your account's region.

text: Free interactive demo for debugging an issue, exploring a service map, or correlating app and Kubernetes errors
quote: Explore our free, interactive demo. Choose your own path: analyze and debug an issue, explore a service map, or correlate app and Kubernetes errors.
